controller.Win32-Front.label: Desktop - Live Capture
controller.Win32-Front.description: Uses live desktop capture and Seize mouse input for foreground throw gestures.
controller.Win32-Window-Background.label: Desktop - Background Window
controller.Win32-Window-Background.descr: Sends mouse messages to the target window in the background. Availability depends on target window support.
controller.Win32-Interception.label: Desktop - Interception Mouse Injection
controller.Win32-Interception.descriptio: Uses live desktop capture and injects mouse events through the Interception driver. Only the mouse path uses Interception; keyboard remains PostMessage.
resource.default.label: Default Resource
group.assist.label: Assist
task.PipaBirdThrow.label: Pipa Bird Auto-Aim Throw
task.PipaBirdThrow.description: Presses E once, continuously detects Pipa Birds, holds the left button while aiming, and releases only after two centered target checks. Stops when the task is stopped. Requires the pipa_bird.onnx model.
task.YueyaXuexiongThrow.label: Yueya Snow Bear Blue Aim Throw
task.YueyaXuexiongThrow.description: Presses E once, continuously detects saturated blue Yueya Snow Bear regions, and releases only after consecutive centered target checks. Stops when the task is stopped.
task.YueyaXuexiongExploreThrow.label: Yueya Snow Bear Explore Throw
task.YueyaXuexiongExploreThrow.descripti: Sweeps left and right with the right mouse button, presses E once after finding a high-confidence Yueya Snow Bear, then aims and throws. Stops when the task is stopped.
option.PipaBirdAimGain.label: Aim Movement Ratio
option.PipaBirdAimGain.description: Converts target offset into relative mouse movement. Calibrate it for the in-game sensitivity.
option.PipaBirdAimGain.inputs.AimGainPer: Range: 1-300. Lower values under-correct; higher values can overshoot.
option.YueyaXuexiongAimGain.label: Snow Bear Aim Movement Ratio
option.YueyaXuexiongAimGain.description: Converts the blue target offset into relative mouse movement. Calibrate it for the in-game sensitivity.
option.YueyaXuexiongAimGain.inputs.AimGa: Range: 1-300. Lower values under-correct; higher values can overshoot.
option.PipaBirdCenterTolerance.label: Crosshair Center Tolerance
option.PipaBirdCenterTolerance.descripti: Throws only when consecutive checks keep the target center within this many pixels of the crosshair.
option.PipaBirdCenterTolerance.inputs.Ce: Range: 1-200. Smaller values are more precise but harder to satisfy.
option.YueyaXuexiongCenterTolerance.desc: Throws only when consecutive checks keep the blue target center within this many pixels of the crosshair.
option.YueyaXuexiongCenterTolerance.inpu: Range: 1-200. Smaller values are more precise but harder to satisfy.
option.PipaBirdThrowCooldown.label: Throw Cooldown
option.PipaBirdThrowCooldown.description: Waits after each throw for the game state to update.
option.YueyaXuexiongThrowCooldown.label: Snow Bear Throw Cooldown
option.YueyaXuexiongThrowCooldown.descri: Waits after each throw for the game state to update.
task.TargetPetSearchThrow.label: Search Target Pet Throw Strategy
task.TargetPetSearchThrow.description: Holds aim while searching for the selected pet, adjusts the camera in stages, and releases when the target box center enters the crosshair tolerance.
option.TargetPetModel.label: Target pet model
option.TargetPetModel.description: Select the detector used for this search-and-throw run.
option.TargetPetModel.case.Huolong.label: Huolong (RocoPilot)
option.TargetPetModel.case.Huolong.descr: RocoPilot's huolong.pt. Its embedded class name is xueren and its current long-range confidence is low.
task.RandomThrow.label: Random Throw Mode
task.RandomThrow.description: Presses E once, then repeats throws with randomized click hold duration and randomized interval.
option.RandomThrowClickDuration.label: Click Hold Range
option.RandomThrowClickDuration.descript: Randomized hold duration for each throw click.
option.RandomThrowDelayRange.label: Delay Range
